coverage.finding: The source image shows '313' in dark ink or pencil at the top of the left margin column, at about x 420–580, y 300–440. A raised superscript letter follows it, consistent with 'b'. This matches the supplied folio label 'fol. 313b'. The candidate's literal text and position are accurate.

There are very faint grey marks at about x 555–680, y 400–530: a short dash or box-like stroke above, and a faint group of numerals below.
